title: Tests inherit enclosing project state when temporary directories are inside the workspace
findings_note: S52 validation; three failures with workspace-local TMPDIR

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Running the suite with TMPDIR inside this checkout causes two outside-project tests to discover the enclosing .slicer directory, and a not-a-Git-repository test to discover its Git repository. S52 validation ran 443 tests with these three failures. Workspace-restricted contributors need an isolated way to run the suite.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: The outside-project and not-a-Git-repository tests should retain their intended meaning when temporary directories live beneath a slicer/Git project.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Provide test isolation for parent-project discovery without changing production discovery semantics. Document how to run the suite within a workspace boundary.

**Not in this slice:** changing slicer root discovery or weakening assertions to accept inherited state.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run the full suite with temporary directories inside the checkout and confirm isolation, including the three previously failing cases.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Follow owner instructions; no automatic commit.
